title: 2유닛 장면 · 2
prompt: Children's picture-book illustration, hand-drawn 2D style, thick soft dark-brown outlines, flat bright cheerful colors with a light paper texture and gentle watercolor shading, rounded friendly shapes. No photo-realism, no 3D render look. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene with a simple uncluttered background and a calm, simple sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. The characters must look exactly like the ones in the attached character sheet (left to right: Lily, Max, Pomi, Digby). Scene: Beside the pond, a hen's nest in the grass holds three white eggs, one of them glowing gold like a seed. Max kneels and gently points at the glowing egg; Lily holds a finger to her lips. Behind them a new letter tree with duck-, dog- and doll-shaped fruits has sprouted. Hidden in the picture: a tiny elf peeking from behind a flower pot, a small green exit-style sign with a running figure on the garden shed door. Characters: Lily is a cheerful 7-year-old East Asian girl with a straight black bob haircut and a small red hair clip, wearing a bright yellow hoodie, blue shorts and green rain boots. Max is a shy 7-year-old East Asian boy with short curly brown hair, a blue cap worn backwards, an orange t-shirt, dark blue pants, white sneakers and a small green backpack. Pomi is a round apple-green garden sprite the size of a melon, with one small sprout leaf on top of its head, big shiny black eyes, rosy pink cheeks, tiny stubby arms and no legs (it hops and floats), softly glowing. Digby is a grumpy old grey mole with a red-and-white striped nightcap, round spectacles, big pink digging paws and a tiny pink nose.
